summary: Verified new 'Resend code' feature on password-reset screen (frontend + backend). Backend: POST /api/auth/forgot-password 1st call returns 200 ('If an account exists...'), 2nd call within 60s returns 429 with 'A code was just sent. Please wait a minute before requesting another.' Frontend at 390px mobile viewport: /auth → forgot-password-link → submit fixture email qa.resend.88236@example.com → mode 'Enter your code'; resend-code-countdown visible ('Resend available in 60s'), resend-code-btn NOT present. After ~60s countdown expired, resend-code-btn appeared; clicking it produced toast 'A fresh code is on its way — check your inbox.', countdown restarted (58s observed), resend-code-btn hidden again. No horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth-clientWidth=0). All assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.jsx resendCode: On 429 sets cooldown=60 which is correct UX (aligns with backend cooldown). On other errors cooldown is not touched — fine.
resend cooldown timer is client-side only; user can bypass by refreshing the page, but backend 429 enforces the true 60s window, so behavior is safe.
seed_data_creation: Registered qa.resend.<rand>@example.com via /api/auth/register for testing (session teardown in conftest purges @example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resend-code UX verified end-to-end. data-testids used: resend-code-countdown, resend-code-btn, reset-code-input, new-password-input, forgot-password-link. Countdown starts at 60 after forgot submission and after each resend click. Backend 60s cooldown returns 429.
